name: unroomedflag-simple
description: Simple ladder for unroomedFlag (Un-roomed area flag): opens the 2D plan editor, confirms the Kitchen's floor area is covered by a real room fill (fully-roomed default flat), then removes the Kitchen room (removeRoom keeps its walls) and asserts that same point is no LONGER covered by any room fill (the red un-roomed polygon underneath is now the topmost thing showing there) — then undoes and asserts the room fill covers it again. The polygon itself is a static, pointer-events:none full-building outline drawn BENEATH the RoomsLayer (so it's occlusion-tested via DOM room-fill coverage, not element-picking, which pointer-events:none defeats — elementFromPoint skips pointer-events:none shapes entirely). unroomedFlag is simple-tier (present in both Simple and Pro) — asserted ON in both modes.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-unroomedflag-on-in-simple
steps.failMessage: unroomedFlag should be ON in Simple mode (it is simple-tier)

steps.name: verify-kitchen-point-covered-by-room-fill

waitFor.store: (() => { const x = 816, y = 748; return [...document.querySelectorAll("[fill^='var(--surface']")].some((el) => { const b = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return x >= b.left && x <= b.right && y >= b.top && y <= b.bottom; }); })()

steps.failMessage: Expected the Kitchen's floor area to be covered by a room fill on the fully-roomed default flat

steps.name: verify-room-removed
steps.failMessage: Expected the kitchen room to be removed from the plan

steps.name: verify-unroomed-flag-appears

waitFor.store: (() => { const x = 816, y = 748; return ![...document.querySelectorAll("[fill^='var(--surface']")].some((el) => { const b = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return x >= b.left && x <= b.right && y >= b.top && y <= b.bottom; }); })()

steps.failMessage: Expected NO room fill to cover the Kitchen's floor area once the kitchen room (but not its walls) is removed — the red un-roomed polygon underneath should now show

steps.name: verify-room-restored
steps.failMessage: Expected undo to restore the kitchen room

steps.name: verify-unroomed-flag-clears

waitFor.store: (() => { const x = 816, y = 748; return [...document.querySelectorAll("[fill^='var(--surface']")].some((el) => { const b = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return x >= b.left && x <= b.right && y >= b.top && y <= b.bottom; }); })()

steps.failMessage: Expected the Kitchen room fill to cover its area again once restored by undo

steps.name: verify-unroomedflag-on-in-pro
steps.failMessage: unroomedFlag should still be ON in Pro mode (simple-tier flags are shown in both modes)

steps.name: verify-unroomed-flag-in-pro

waitFor.store: (() => { const x = 816, y = 748; return ![...document.querySelectorAll("[fill^='var(--surface']")].some((el) => { const b = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return x >= b.left && x <= b.right && y >= b.top && y <= b.bottom; }); })()

steps.failMessage: The un-roomed flag should still work identically in Pro mode
